posts.zh:
dsh-powerdesk 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9239b9648f29f6bbde42.html
posts.en:
dsh-powerdesk is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9239b9648f29f6bbde42.html
